name: Ferienwohnung Mairhofer
beschreibung:
Peacefully situated in the Thiersee valley, Ferienwohnung Mairhofer provides ideal conditions for a relaxing getaway with bright rooms and a sunny balcony.

Lake Thiersee and scenic walking paths ascending Mount Pendling are within close reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Mairhofer in Thiersee offers comfortable holiday accommodations and mountain views in Kufsteinerland.
